products.name: Organic Vegan Banana Walnut Bread
products.description: Enjoy our fresh, organic, gluten-free vegan banana bread, baked in small batches with simple ingredients.
products.about: During our January 21st sale, we introduced samples of this vegan, gluten-free banana walnut bread for everyone to try. The response was overwhelmingly positive, with many of you sharing how much you loved it. One of the Sai Kids even mentioned they couldn’t tell the difference between the original and the new recipe—a testament to the flavor, texture, and quality we strive for in every bite. We’ve poured our heart and soul into crafting this version to ensure it’s just as delicious and satisfying as the classic one we all cherish— because great taste should never come with compromises. We’re delighted to offer this inclusive treat for everyone to enjoy. Whether you’re gluten-free, vegan, or simply a fan of amazing banana bread, this one’s for you!
products.howToEnjoy: Savor our Organic Vegan Banana Walnut Bread as a quick, grab-and-go breakfast or a delightful afternoon snack!

products.name: Organic Simply Spelt Sandwich Bread
products.description: Organic, diabetic-friendly and prebiotic sandwich bread made from ancient spelt.
products.speltInfo: Spelt flour is unique for a variety of reasons. With its mild, nutty flavor, Spelt is an ancient variety of wheat that is more satiating compared to regular wheat and helps prevent blood sugar spikes. Although it contains gluten, its molecular composition is different— more fragile and water soluble—making it easier to digest. Additionally, Spelt is higher in fiber than wheat, aiding in gluten digestion. It also contains magnesium and zinc, which contribute to overall sleep quality and immunity.
products.ourDream: Our dream is to open an artisinal bakery at Haritachala (Tiruvannamalai, India). This Sandwich bread is one of the first products being launched from our Haritachala Bakery lineup. We hope you savor the healthy, high- quality ingredients in these traditional recipes and feel our love and passion in every bite. We wholeheartedly seek your blessings and your valuable feedback. May each bite of our artisanal bread offer a soulful experience, bringing families and friends together in shared moments of culinary joy. Our Artisanal Bakers, Hasita and Tanvi, have dedicated countless hours to cultivating their own mother yeast, experimenting with various wheat flours, and perfecting the recipe. Our Sandwich Bread is just the first of many handcrafted products we want to share with you!

products.name: Artisinal Cranberry Andhra Pachadi
products.tagline: flavors that speak తెలుగు with a cranberry accent
products.description: An innovative cranberry pachadi created in our kitchen, blending tangy cranberries with traditional Andhra spices using a cherished family recipe.
products.about: Cranberry Andhra Pachadi beautifully represents our essence - a fusion of rich Telugu culinary heritage and contemporary western upbringing. Cranberries, native to North America, offer distinct health benefits when grown and consumed locally, ensuring better assimilation into our bodies. Consuming seasonal fruits aligns with healthier living principles, and in this harmonious marriage of flavors, we spotlight locally-sourced ingredients.
servingSuggestions: Pair it with dosa, idli, or vada for a tangy twist
Swap it for your regular pachadis for a vitamin-packed punch
Spread it on bread or use as a dip for a zesty snack
Serve as a flavorful accompaniment with pappu and curd rice
Mix it into steaming hot rice, drizzle ghee on top, and savor true Andhra bliss
